note: Only two criteria are testable from this call and they point in opposite directions. Neglected health is a clear match: a 45-year-old office worker at roughly 25% body fat who has let it slide and now frames the problem in exactly the ICP's terms, as the one area that has fallen behind. Not deconditioned is the miss — at 25% body fat with belly fat as the presenting complaint, a pattern of losing four pounds and regaining them, and daily ice cream, he sits close to the profile the stated ICP explicitly excludes. He is not gym-averse, which is the mitigating fact, but the starting point is closer to weight loss than to good-to-great. Successful and income cannot be judged at all: occupation was never asked, no price was presented and money was never discussed, so both are left out of both lists rather than guessed. This call ended before the ICP could really be tested, which is itself the point — the process spends twenty-five minutes on emotional discovery and never once asks what the prospect does for a living.
